turns.speaker: Trainer
turns.text: Futhi namukelekile kwi-module yenu yokugcina yokufunda ngababili nokufunda ngokuzimela.
turns.en: And welcome to your last module of paired reading and independent reading.

turns.speaker: Trainer
turns.text: Kubalulekile ukuthi uma sekuyisikhathi sokufunda ngababili noma ngokuzimela, uqale ngokuhlela izincwadi esebezifundile ngamaqembu ukuze kube lula ukufunda.
turns.en: It is important that when it is time for paired or independent reading, you start by organizing the books they have already read in groups so that it is easy to read.

turns.speaker: Trainer
turns.en: For example, learners reading to each other.

turns.speaker: Trainer
turns.text: Ucabanga yini ukuthi ungayibona yenzeke engadini?
turns.en: Do you think you can see it happening in the garden?

turns.speaker: Trainer
turns.text: Ucabanga yini ongayibona yenzeke endabeni? Umfundi ebuza omunye umfundi.
turns.en: What do you think you can see happening in the story? A learner asking another learner.

turns.speaker: Trainer
turns.text: Emuva kokuqeda le-module uzokwazi ukuchaza ukuthi kuyini ukufunda ngababili nangokuzimela.
turns.en: After completing this module you will be able to explain what paired and independent reading is.

turns.speaker: Trainer
turns.en: To explain the benefit of paired and independent reading.

turns.speaker: Trainer
turns.text: Ukukhombisa ukuqonda kokuhlela indawo efanele ezothuthukisa amathuba okufunda ngababili nangokuzimela.
turns.en: To show understanding of organizing a suitable space that will promote opportunities for paired and independent reading.

turns.speaker: Trainer
turns.text: Ukungaveza impumela emihle yokufunda ngokuqondisisa nangolwazimagama.
turns.en: To show the positive outcome of reading with comprehension and vocabulary.

turns.speaker: Trainer
turns.text: Ukucacisa ukuthi angafundiswa kanjani amasu okufunda
turns.en: To clarify how reading strategies can be taught

turns.speaker: Trainer
turns.text: Kulo mqeqesho uzofunda ukuthi ungafundiswa kanjani amasu okufunda ngababili nangokuzimela.
turns.en: In this training you will learn how paired and independent reading strategies can be taught.
